title: Notice Writing
summary: A notice is a short, formal written announcement displayed on a notice board or published to inform a group about an event, change or instruction. In the board exam it carries 4 marks with a limit of about 50 words, and marks depend as much on the correct boxed format as on complete content.

notes.heading: What a notice is and where it appears
notes.html:
A notice gives information to a specific group of people (students, residents, members, employees). It is issued by an institution or office and signed by a responsible person. Common subjects: events, competitions, meetings, lost and found, change of schedule, camps, drives and campaigns.

In the exam you choose one of two notices. Word limit: about 50 words (the content inside the box, not counting the name of the institution, date and signature).

notes.heading: Format
notes.html:
Write the notice inside a box.

NAME OF THE INSTITUTION / ORGANISATION
NOTICE
Date
HEADING (in capitals)
Body: what, when, where, who, how to register / contact
Signature
Name (in capitals)
Designation

Some schools also show the word NOTICE first and the institution second; either is accepted if consistent.

notes.heading: Marking scheme (4 marks)
notes.html:
ComponentMarks
Format (institution name, NOTICE, date, heading, writer’s name and designation)1
Content (all relevant details)2
Expression (accuracy, fluency, appropriate words)1

notes.heading: Steps to write
notes.html:
1. Identify the issuing authority and its designation (Head Girl, Secretary, Cultural Secretary).
  2. Write a short, catchy heading in capitals.
  3. Cover the five Ws: what event, when (date, day, time), where (venue), who is eligible, why or purpose.
  4. Add how to register or whom to contact and a last date.
  5. Close with the name and designation.

notes.heading: Do’s and don’ts
notes.html:
Do

  • Use the passive voice or impersonal tone: ‘Students are informed…’.
  • Use the name given in the question; otherwise write ABC School / XYZ.
  • Keep sentences short and factual.

Don’t

  • Don’t write in first person plural (‘we are going to…’) excessively.
  • Don’t add your own address, roll number or ‘Dear students’.
  • Don’t exceed the word limit or leave the box incomplete.
  • Don’t sign with your real name if the question gives one.

notes.heading: Useful phrases
notes.html:
• All students are hereby informed that…
  • The school is organising… under the aegis of…
  • Interested students may give their names to the undersigned latest by…
  • Attendance is compulsory for…
  • For further details, contact…
  • The finder is requested to return it to…

notes.heading: Complete sample
notes.html:
Question: You are Ritika / Rohan, Head of the Eco Club, Sunrise Public School, Jaipur. Write a notice inviting students of Classes 9–12 to a ‘Plastic-Free Campus’ drive.

SUNRISE PUBLIC SCHOOL, JAIPUR
NOTICE
14 August 20XX
JOIN THE PLASTIC-FREE CAMPUS DRIVE

The Eco Club will hold a Plastic-Free Campus Drive on 22 August 20XX (Friday) from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Students of Classes 9–12 will collect plastic waste, set up segregation bins and make cloth bags. Gloves and refreshments will be provided. Interested students may register with the undersigned by 19 August.

Rohan Mehta
ROHAN MEHTA
Head, Eco Club

keyTerms.definition: A brief formal announcement addressed to a specific group and displayed publicly.
A short title in capitals that tells the reader the subject of the notice at a glance.
The person, with designation, who writes and signs the notice on behalf of the institution.
Formal word for the person who has signed the notice; used in ‘contact the undersigned’.
What, when, where, who, why: the core details every notice must contain.
A style that avoids personal pronouns and emotion, e.g. ‘Students are informed’.

mcqs.q: What is the word limit for a notice in the CBSE Class 12 board exam?
mcqs.explanation: A notice is a short message of about 50 words; 120–150 words is the limit for letters, articles and reports.

mcqs.q: How many marks are given for the format of a notice?
mcqs.explanation: The 4 marks are split as format 1, content 2 and expression 1.

mcqs.q: Which of these is NOT part of the notice format?
mcqs.explanation: A notice has no salutation; it addresses a group impersonally. Date, heading and designation are compulsory.

mcqs.q: Which opening line best suits a notice?
options: All students are hereby informed that the annual sports meet will be held on…
I am very happy to tell you all that…
Respected Principal, I want to say…
mcqs.explanation: Notices are formal and impersonal. The other options are chatty, overly personal, or written like a letter.

mcqs.q: The heading of a notice should be:
options: a full sentence in lower case
short, in capital letters, stating the subject
mcqs.explanation: A good heading is short, in capitals and states the subject, e.g. INTER-HOUSE QUIZ. It comes before the body.

mcqs.q: A notice for a lost wristwatch must include all EXCEPT:
options: where and when it was lost
mcqs.explanation: Description, place and time, and contact are needed to identify and return it. The price is irrelevant and wastes words.

mcqs.q: Where should the words count for a notice be focused?
options: On the body of the notice inside the box
On the date and heading only
mcqs.explanation: The ~50-word limit applies to the body; the format elements are not counted strictly.

mcqs.q: Which voice is most commonly used in notices?
mcqs.explanation: Notices commonly use the passive voice (‘Students are informed’, ‘Entries are invited’) because it is formal and impersonal.

questions.q: You are Ananya / Arjun, Cultural Secretary of Green Valley School, Pune. Write a notice in about 50 words inviting names for an inter-house debate competition.
questions.answerHtml:
GREEN VALLEY SCHOOL, PUNE
NOTICE
3 September 20XX
INTER-HOUSE DEBATE COMPETITION

An inter-house debate on the topic ‘Artificial Intelligence Will Create More Jobs Than It Destroys’ will be held on 15 September 20XX at 10:00 a.m. in the auditorium. Each house may send two speakers from Classes 10–12. Names should reach the undersigned by 10 September. Speaking time: three minutes each.

Arjun Rao
ARJUN RAO
Cultural Secretary

questions.q: You are Kavya / Kunal, Secretary of Shanti Nagar Residents’ Welfare Association, Lucknow. Write a notice informing residents about a two-day water supply cut for pipeline repair.
questions.answerHtml:
SHANTI NAGAR RESIDENTS’ WELFARE ASSOCIATION, LUCKNOW
NOTICE
18 June 20XX
WATER SUPPLY SUSPENSION

Residents are informed that the water supply will remain suspended on 21 and 22 June 20XX (Saturday and Sunday) from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. for repair of the main pipeline. Residents are requested to store sufficient water in advance. A tanker will be stationed near Block C for emergencies. Inconvenience is regretted.

Kunal Verma
KUNAL VERMA
Secretary, RWA

questions.q: You are Meera / Manav, Head Girl / Head Boy of DAV Public School, Patna. Write a notice about a blood donation camp organised by the school for parents and staff.
questions.answerHtml:
DAV PUBLIC SCHOOL, PATNA
NOTICE
2 October 20XX
BLOOD DONATION CAMP

The school, in association with the City Red Cross Society, is organising a blood donation camp on 12 October 20XX from 9:00 a.m. to 2:00 p.m. in the school gym. Parents and staff aged 18–60 in good health may donate. A doctor will conduct a free check-up. Register at the school reception by 9 October.

Meera Singh
MEERA SINGH
Head Girl

questions.q: You are Sana / Samar of St. Paul’s School, Bhopal. You lost a blue geometry box in the library. Write a lost-and-found notice.
questions.answerHtml:
ST. PAUL’S SCHOOL, BHOPAL
NOTICE
9 November 20XX
LOST: GEOMETRY BOX

A blue metal geometry box with the initials ‘S.K.’ engraved on the lid was lost in the school library on 8 November 20XX between 11:00 a.m. and 12:00 noon. It contains a scientific calculator and a steel compass. The finder is requested to return it to the undersigned in Class 12-B or to the library counter.

Samar Khan
SAMAR KHAN
Class 12-B

questions.q: You are Ishita / Ishaan, President of the Literary Club, Kendriya Vidyalaya, Dehradun. Write a notice announcing a creative writing workshop with a visiting author.
questions.answerHtml:
KENDRIYA VIDYALAYA, DEHRADUN
NOTICE
25 July 20XX
CREATIVE WRITING WORKSHOP

The Literary Club is organising a two-day creative writing workshop on 5 and 6 August 20XX from 2:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. in the library. A noted children’s author will guide participants in short story and poetry writing. Students of Classes 9–12 may enrol with the undersigned by 1 August. Seats are limited to forty.

Ishaan Negi
ISHAAN NEGI
President, Literary Club
